identification.summary: The Infrastructure Destruction Squad is a Telegram-based threat actor brand that KELA describes as presenting itself as politically motivated but appearing largely profit-driven, active since at least June 2025, centered on selling access and developing Malware-as-a-Service offerings [S1]. Malpedia lists Dark Engine as an alias and describes ICS/SCADA-targeted incidents with a surge in June 2025 [S2]. The group has stated that Dark Engine is a separate organization linked to its channel only through 'friends' [S1].
identification.notes: The group posts in English, Russian and Chinese and says its members are mostly in China with others in Russia, Belarus and the United States (self-described, per KELA) [S1]. The existing encyclopedia record lists country RU; no reviewed source supports that and it conflicts with the group's self-description [S1]. Not to be confused with the 2023 Cyber Anarchy Squad (separate Ukrainian-aligned group) [S1].

attribution.basis: No reviewed source attributes the group to a state sponsor. KELA assesses it as appearing largely profit-driven despite political framing [S1]. Member nationality claims are self-reported [S1].

objectives: KELA assesses the brand is largely profit-driven, selling access and developing MaaS products, despite a politically motivated presentation [S1]. Claimed intrusions also serve publicity: its Venice post said it was 'simply here to deliver a message' [S4].

sectors: Industrial control systems / SCADA (metallurgy, food processing) [S2]
targeting.notes: All infrastructure intrusions are self-reported claims on Telegram; independent confirmation was not found [S4][S5].

capabilities.summary: KELA reports the group's best-known product is the BLACKNET-00 ransomware builder, first offered for sale in April 2026 at a $300 price point [S1]. The channel advertises a 'TRK25 Advanced SCADA' scanning tool for sale and a claimed 'VoltRuptor ICS' tool for sabotaging control devices [S5]. A claimed French hydro intrusion reportedly used an exposed VNC service [S5]. Malpedia also ties the alias to a fake-CAPTCHA/SEO-poisoning WordPress credential-harvesting campaign [S2]; this link is unverified here.

campaigns.name: ICS/SCADA incident surge
campaigns.summary: Malpedia describes multiple ICS-targeted incidents with a pronounced surge in June 2025, in sectors such as metallurgy and food processing [S2].

campaigns.name: Dark Engine distancing statement
campaigns.summary: The group stated Dark Engine was a separate organization linked to its channel only through friends [S1].

campaigns.name: Venice San Marco flood pump claim
campaigns.summary: The group claimed administrative access to Venice's San Marco anti-flood pump system, offered root access for $600, and released control-panel screenshots as proof; claims are unverified, and one secondary source says authorities stated defenses remained operational [S4].

campaigns.name: BLACKNET-00 ransomware builder offered
campaigns.summary: Ransomware builder first offered for sale at $300 [S1].

campaigns.name: Mahanagar Gas (Mumbai) and French hydro claims
campaigns.summary: Telegram posts announced a countdown to sabotage Mahanagar Gas control devices with VoltRuptor ICS, and described a French hydro plant interface reached via exposed VNC and taken offline; no independent verification found [S5].

diamond.adversary: Telegram-based brand, self-described multinational membership, assessed largely profit-driven [S1].
diamond.capability: BLACKNET-00 builder, claimed VoltRuptor ICS, TRK25 SCADA scanner [S1][S5].
diamond.infrastructure: Telegram channel (infrastructurek) used for claims and sales [S5].
diamond.victim: Claimed ICS/OT operators in Italy, India, France and the US [S4][S5].
diamond.socioPolitical: Political framing with apparent profit motive [S1].
diamond.technology: Internet-exposed ICS/HMI services such as VNC (claimed) [S5].

provenance.importedSummary: Dark Engine has emerged as a significant threat actor targeting industrial control systems and SCADA systems in sectors such as metallurgy and food processing. The group has conducted multiple ICS-targeted incidents, with a pronounced operational surge in June 2025. Additionally, Dark Engine is involved in a campaign that embeds fraudulent CAPTCHA prompts into legitimate WordPress sites, utilizing SEO poisoning to harvest login credentials. Reports also indicate a data leak from Dark Engine that exposed sensitive phone data in the U.S.
